description: Player 2 deck for specs 30, 31 (player 1 side is 31-spells-a) and 32: 08-do-nothing-b card list. Every card costs 3 or more and none has a Cast-on-draw, a Quickdraw, a hand trigger or a Trap, so player 2 does nothing on the turns these specs pass through and the board and both heroes move only through player 1 plays. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, is dealt as a stand-in (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling its numbers as it stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves it.
